rules.description: A 4x4 row-major board 0..15; Red at 0, Blue at 15; scores 0, Red active, turn 1, MOVE, no winner; exactly one token per player.
In MOVE only the active token may move one orthogonal step to an unoccupied tile; invalid actions preserve the complete state.
A valid move changes only the active position and phase to RESOLVE; all further tile clicks do nothing.
End Turn acts only in RESOLVE and awards exactly one point iff the active token is on beacon 5 or 10.
Unless victory, End Turn alternates active player, increments turn and returns to MOVE.
At score 2 the active player wins and phase becomes GAME_OVER; actions freeze until Reset.
Reset restores every initial value and persists it.
Complete state persists in browser localStorage through full-page reload, including RESOLVE.
Local two-human React route /project-pilots/beacon-relay provides instructions and stable requested selectors with exact numeric and player/phase labels.

invariants.description: Exactly one distinct in-bounds token per player, valid phase/turn/score/winner, deterministic immutable actions.

decisions: No unresolved gameplay questions or extra mechanics. Invalid or unavailable storage falls back to a fresh in-memory game; this defensive behavior does not change approved gameplay.
